summary: First-finish smoke test of Expedition Guardian. Backend auth, briefing (Gemini), phrases, and checklist endpoints all healthy. Frontend core flows (landing, login, dashboard, map, readiness, checklist, briefing render with all 4 blocks, custom item, save-to-vault, offline banner, logout) all pass. Two minor issues to flag.
passed: POST /api/briefing (Chamonix) returns full dossier via Gemini (~15s)
Landing page loads with hero 'Prepare Online. Operate Offline.' and sample dossier
Login redirects to /dashboard; Protected route enforcement works
Leaflet map container renders on dashboard
Readiness gauge updates from 0% -> 6% on checklist tick
Briefing card renders after Chamonix search with weather-info-block, terrain-info-block, water-sources-block, medical-hazards-block
Save to Vault + offline-vault-drawer-toggle shows vault-saved-item-card
Network toggle switches to Offline and shows offline-banner
Theme switcher dropdown opens showing 4 themes (Parisian Chic, Tactical Dark, Deep Jungle, Desert Sand)

failed.issue: After briefing loaded, phrase-item-row count was 0 at check time. Backend /api/phrases returns full data successfully, so likely a rendering/timing issue where phrase pack fetch hadn't completed or wiring to phrasePack prop is delayed. Needs retest with longer wait (10-20s) after briefing before asserting phrase rows.
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/phrases returns valid French pack with 6 emergency phrases; UI locator [data-testid=phrase-item-row] returned count 0 immediately after briefing card appeared.

failed.issue: After opening offline-vault-drawer, the drawer overlay continued to intercept pointer events; Escape did not close the drawer, blocking subsequent click on emergency-action-im-lost. Drawer may lack an Escape/backdrop close handler (UX polish).
failed.evidence: Playwright: 'VaultDrawer subtree intercepts pointer events' retried repeatedly after page.keyboard.press('Escape').

action_items: Verify LanguageVault: ensure Dashboard actually invokes /api/phrases after briefing success and phrasePack state is passed to LanguageVault. If working, this is a test-timing issue only; add a small loading indicator or ensure phrase-item-row appears within ~15s of briefing.
Add Escape/backdrop-click close handler to VaultDrawer for better UX (nice-to-have, not blocker).

Documentation nit: review_request lists theme testids as 'theme-option-*' with short slug (e.g. tactical); actual testids are full slug (theme-option-tactical_dark, theme-option-parisian_chic, theme-option-deep_jungle, theme-option-desert_sand). Either update docs or aliases.
